title: Growth of the Exponential Bound
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the Boolean alphabet and all natural numbers $n,s$, the bound $k_b(N,n,s)$ satisfies $4k_b(N,n,s)\le k_b(N,n,s+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
